page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines about the communion of saints and remission of sins. Catchword at the lower right and signature at the lower left.

main_text.p: Particularis est quivis coetus unius gentis, aut civitatis, aut uniuscujusque particularis loci, Christum colens.
Ecclesiæ Catholicæ bonum tum in Genere, tum in Specie, consideratur.
Bonum ejus in genere, est Communio Sanctorum, quæ est eorundem communium bonorum participatio, ad quæ omnes & soli sancti jus habent.Sanctorum communionem. [?]
Estq; tum Sanctorum cum Deo, tum eorundem inter se.
Communio Sanctorum cum Deo, est gratiosa Dei in credentibus habitatio, omnia ipsis salutaria donafrueda dantis.

Communio Sanctorum inter se, est unio omnium Christi membrorum in unum corpus, per Spiritum Sanctum omnib. inhabitantem facta, eorumq; obligatio ad bona accepta in commune cōmodum, in primis autē in capitis sui Christi gloriam promtē & alacriter conferenda.
Bonum in specie consideratum est triplex.
I. REMISSIO Peccatorum, quâ Deus & culpam & pœnam peccatorum exRemissionis [?]peccatorum.

page.notes: The line at the foot reads "mera" beside the signature "A 5"; it is treated as the catchword. The running head is "CAP. I. SECT. I."; a stray "9" printed beside it is left out. The right margin also shows faint show-through of text from the reverse side, which is not transcribed. The margin note "Sanctorum communionem." is partly hyphenated across three lines and its last word is doubtful. The note "Remissionis" is doubtful. The word "gratiosa" breaks at a line end with a mark that may be a hyphen; it is written whole. Greek and Hebrew: none.
